decision: No raw opening is supplied: G0088.openings is empty. Its inherited qualified lineage and attacks are source context, not current raw candidates. No retained mechanism or replacement is justified, and no proposal is added. The incumbent remains unverified; executable selection ordering and the permissible fixed-label domain remain uncertain. No replay disagreement or favorable performance is observed. An advance, reject or unresolved classifier verdict cannot be established from this empty pool. Any subsequent evaluation must use supplied records and labels, retain the acceptance thresholds (at least four additional correct predictions overall; no slice loss exceeding two), account for every adjudication, and respect sixteen disputed-label adjudications and seventy minutes. Withheld-row access attempts must be logged and consume no allowance. The supplied full-label key may be opened only after both variant reports freeze; it cannot expand live adjudication capacity. Report unresolved uncertainty whenever these limits prevent a supported decision; no deployment-readiness claim follows.
